decisions.reason: As a consumer superfood product with weak fit to the firm's core industrial waste-to-value and engineering trajectory, it looks like a peripheral option that management is likely to abandon to free attention and resources for stronger technology ventures.
This modular waste-to-energy extension fits the firm's existing capabilities and customer base, and with industry growth and still-limited market learning it is worth keeping as an option.
Because it is presented as a flagship and closely matches the firm's strategic focus on sustainable energy-from-waste systems, management would be very likely to continue backing it.
Plastic-waste-to-fuel strongly fits the firm's technological direction and sustainability positioning, so despite uncertainty management would likely keep this option open rather than exit early.
